result.description:
An exciting opportunity has arisen for a highly skilled Database Developer to join a forward-thinking educational institution in Perth.   This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys working across SQL Server, integrations, reporting, and application development, with the opportunity to have a real impact on how data is used across the business.  
      This role sits at the heart of the Information and Learning Technologies team, where your technical expertise will directly support both business and academic operations. You will be instrumental in designing, developing, and maintaining robust data solutions and digital applications that underpin the organisation's strategic goals. This position offers you the chance to work closely with stakeholders across the school community, ensuring reliable, secure, and scalable technology outcomes. The role is perfect for someone who thrives in a supportive environment that values knowledge sharing, professional growth, and making a tangible impact on student wellbeing 
 
 Play a key role in shaping data-driven decision-making by developing integrated solutions that enhance accessibility, reporting, and analytics across the institution. 
 Enjoy flexible working opportunities within a collaborative team that values professional development, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement. 
 Make a real difference by supporting student wellbeing and academic success through innovative use of technology and data intelligence. 
 
     
  Responsibilities:  
     
 
 Serve as the primary system administrator and subject-matter expert for the key projects, overseeing configuration, user management, data integrity, version upgrades, and module administration. 
 Design, maintain, and optimise database schemas and SQL Server infrastructure to ensure high performance, availability, security, and data quality across all systems. 
 Architect, develop, and manage integrations between core CRM platforms, finance systems, cloud identity providers, and communication tools using APIs (REST/SOAP), middleware, and ETL processes. 
 Develop dashboards, reports, self-service analytics tools, and custom queries using platforms like Power BI, Crystal Reports, SSRS or similar to support strategic planning and operational needs. 
 Champion data quality frameworks by implementing profiling, cleansing, validation routines, and advising stakeholders on evidence-based decision-making. 
 Administer database change management processes including updates, release procedures, backup/recovery strategies while ensuring compliance with privacy legislation and organisational policies. 
 Design, develop, test, deploy and maintain custom web applications or internal tools using modern frameworks (Python/.NET/Node.js) aligned with the institution's technology stack. 
 Collaborate with stakeholders from various departments to gather requirements for digital solutions that extend enterprise system capabilities while ensuring secure coding practices are followed. 
 Create comprehensive technical documentation in partnership with key stakeholders; utilise ticketing systems for request tracking; document all changes thoroughly before implementation. 
 
 Mentor IT staff in best practices for database management and application development while staying abreast of emerging technologies. 
 
 
  Requirements:  
 
 Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering or related discipline is essential for this role. 
 Advanced proficiency in Microsoft SQL Server technologies including T-SQL scripting, query optimisation techniques as well as experience with SSIS/SSRS or equivalent reporting tools is required. 
 Demonstrated ability to design API-based or middleware integrations (REST/SOAP/webhooks/ETL/Wonde) along with strong skills in ASP.NET/PowerShell/scripting languages is necessary. 
 Solid application development experience using one or more programming languages such as Python/C#/.NET/Node.js/PHP is expected. 
 Proven track record delivering business intelligence solutions using Power BI/Tableau/SSRS/Microsoft Fabric/Crystal Reports or similar platforms is highly valued. 
 Comprehensive understanding of data governance principles including privacy legislation (Australian Privacy Act/APP) plus information security best practices is mandatory. 
 Minimum five years experience in senior database administration or application development roles ideally within education or enterprise environments is preferred. 
 Excellent business analysis skills encompassing risk assessment solution design capabilities coupled with outstanding troubleshooting/problem-solving abilities are vital. 
 Exceptional communication skills enabling clear translation of technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders alongside proven stakeholder engagement experience are important attributes. 
 A positive outlook combined with willingness to embrace organisational values around service/integrity/stewardship plus demonstrated commitment to health & safety policies is expected. 
    Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Peoples are encouraged to apply.  
 To apply please click apply or call  Milena Wawrzyniak-Kalyanpur on +61 8 9266 0980 for a confidential discussion.

result.description:
Locations	 South Brisbane, QLD, 4101
Full-Time	 Immediate start
Reports to	 Manager
Job Title	 Reception Centre Manager
Salary range	 $79,500 - $90,000 + Superannuation – depending on skill level
Job Closure date	 30 days

About Our Client
Our client is an award-winning luxury hotel, renowned as a vibrant and sophisticated landmark that seamlessly blends contemporary design with unparalleled, personalized service. This dynamic precinct is a hub of luxury accommodation, exclusive retail, and world-class dining, celebrated for creating immersive and memorable experiences from the moment a guest arrives. The atmosphere is one of modern energy and refined comfort, setting a new standard for hospitality.

About the Role
We are recruiting on behalf of our client for a distinguished Reception Centre Manager to serve as the operational leader of the hotel’s reception and guest services teams. This pivotal role is the embodiment of the hotel’s brand at the frontline, responsible for the entire guest arrival and departure experience. You will be the strategic leader ensuring the seamless operation of the reception centre, from managing room allocations and concierge services to mentoring a team of professionals dedicated to creating flawless first and last impressions. This position requires a unique blend of strategic oversight, hands-on leadership, and a passion for delivering exceptional guest interactions.

Key Responsibilities & Duties

Guest Experience & Service Leadership
• Provide inspirational leadership and strategic direction to the front office team, including Reception, Concierge, and Guest Services, setting the benchmark for five-star service standards and personalized guest interactions.
• Oversee the entire guest journey through the reception centre, from pre-arrival planning and streamlined check-in/check-out processes to resolving any concerns with discretion, efficiency, and a genuine desire to exceed expectations.
• Act as a visible and approachable presence on the floor, personally welcoming VIP guests, overseeing complex arrivals and departures, and ensuring the lobby environment consistently reflects the hotel’s energy and sophistication.

Operational Excellence & Administration
• Manage all operational aspects of the reception centre, including room inventory management, billing and folio accuracy, and the efficient handling of all guest correspondence and administrative tasks.
• Develop, implement, and refine front office procedures and systems to maximize efficiency, enhance the guest experience, and ensure flawless communication between departments such as Housekeeping, Maintenance, and Sales.
• Take full responsibility for the security and confidentiality of guest information, safe deposit box procedures, and key card management, upholding the highest standards of safety and privacy.

Team Management & Development
• Lead the recruitment, training, and ongoing professional development of the front office team, fostering a culture of excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement.
• Manage team performance through regular reviews, constructive feedback, and the creation of structured development plans to nurture talent from within.
• Prepare and manage staff rosters to ensure optimal staffing levels that align with occupancy forecasts and business demands, while also controlling labour costs and maintaining service quality.

Financial & Strategic Contribution
• Analyze front office performance data, including guest satisfaction scores and financial reports, to identify trends, drive revenue opportunities, and contribute to the strategic planning of the department.
• Manage departmental budgets and control expenses related to front office operations, including supplies and team-related costs, without compromising the luxury guest experience.

Candidate Profile & Requirements
• Proven experience in a senior Front Office or Reception Management role within a luxury hotel environment.
• A natural leader with exceptional interpersonal and communication skills, capable of inspiring a team and building genuine rapport with guests and colleagues.
• Impeccable organizational skills and a meticulous eye for detail, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, dynamic setting.
• Strong financial and business acumen, with experience in budgeting, rostering, and performance analysis.
• Comprehensive knowledge of hotel property management systems (e.g., Opera) and front office procedures.
• A professional and polished demeanour, with the flexibility to work across a rotating roster, including evenings, weekends, and public holidays.

To Apply
If you are a hospitality professional with the vision and expertise to lead the front line of a prestigious luxury hotel, we invite you to apply. Please submit your resume and a cover letter outlining your leadership philosophy and suitability for this role.

Please note: All applications will be treated with strict confidentiality. We are acting as the exclusive recruitment partner for this role and our client's identity will be disclosed to shortlisted candidates.

result.description: Coastline Panel & Paint Max Auto Smash Repairs     Core Duties and Responsibilities   Electronic Diagnostics & Troubleshooting: Perform complex electronic fault-finding and diagnostics on collision-damaged vehicles using specialized automotive scan tools and computers.  DTC Management: Read, interpret, and clear Diagnostic Trouble Codes (DTCs), establishing clear pathways for resetting electronic control units (ECUs).  Pre & Post-Scan Assessments: Conduct exhaustive pre-scan assessments to map crash impact damage and post-scan vehicle assessments to certify mechanical safety before delivery.  System Calibration & Configuration: Execute precise calibration and configuration of advanced electronic vehicle systems, including Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS) such as radar, cameras, proximity sensors, and airbag modules.  Technical Assessment & Repair Planning: Conduct physical and electronic assessments of vehicle damage, supporting management with repair planning, determining OEM repair procedures, and identifying safety-critical mechanical and electronic components.  Maintenance & Repair Execution: Perform mechanical assembly/disassembly, routine, and emergency maintenance on mechanical assemblies, steering geometry, suspension components, and hydraulic systems impacted by collision forces.  Procurement Support: Prepare highly accurate parts lists, component requirements, and specialized technical repair specifications.  Quality Control & Compliance: Perform strict quality control inspections post-repair, verifying exact component alignment, fitment, and electronic functionality.  Workshop Technical Support: Provide active technical guidance to panel beating and body-repair staff during vehicle strip and refit operations.  Documentation: Fully document diagnostic data, calibration results, and repair procedures to maintain compliance with safety and insurance frameworks.   Skills, Qualifications & Experience Required   Qualifications: A relevant formal qualification  Experience: A minimum of 2 to 3 years of hands-on experience working with complex  electromechanical assemblies, technical diagnostics, and system testing/calibration. Prior experience diagnosing faults using technical scanners and software is essential.    Skills:  Excellent problem-solving skills with the ability to trouble shoot, investigate and rectify Exceptional ability to read and interpret complex technical drawings, mechanical designs, and electronic circuit paths. Strong diagnostic capabilities and a methodical approach to system calibration are required. High-level attention to detail for safety-critical component alignment  About Company     Coastline Panel & Paint Max Auto Smash Repairs (CPMA) is a busy, clean, modern panel shop located in Tweed Heads. As vehicles evolve into highly complex electromechanical systems, our workshop relies heavily on advanced electronic diagnostic and recalibration procedures to return collision-damaged vehicles to original manufacturer safety standards.     We are seeking a skilled Mechanical Technician to lead our diagnostic, mechanical teardown, and systems configuration division. ICBM SERVICES PTY LTD is looking for an experienced Chef for our client's restaurants across NSW, WA in Australia.
On a full-time basis, you will be part of a multidisciplinary and well-supported team.

Title: Chef, Full- time position
Salary: A$ 90,000.00 to 98,000.00 plus super
Work Location: In person.

We are looking for applicants who demonstrate the following:
Requirements

• Certificate IV in Kitchen Management and Diploma in Hospitality Management or in a related field.
• Proven experience as a Chef for at least 2 years.
• Knowledge of automotive systems, engines, transmissions and other mechanical components.
• Skills: Essential skills for chefs include knife proficiency, culinary creativity, time management, leadership,
communication, and the ability to work efficiently under pressure.
• Good communication and teamwork skills.
• Personal Qualities: Chefs must demonstrate passion for food, attention to detail, adaptability, resilience, and a
commitment to continuous learning.
• The job often requires standing for long hours, lifting heavy pots and pans, and working in hot, fast-paced
environments.

Responsibilities
• Menu Planning and Development: Chefs are responsible for designing menus that reflect the restaurant’s concept,
appeal to customers, and are cost-effective. This includes creating new dishes, updating existing ones, and ensuring a
balance of Flavors and nutrition.
• Food Preparation and Cooking: A chef supervises and often participates in the preparation and cooking of food,
ensuring every dish meets the establishment's standards for quality, presentation, and taste.
• Supervision and Leadership: Chefs lead kitchen teams, delegating tasks to sous chefs, line cooks, and kitchen
assistants. They are responsible for training new staff, fostering teamwork, and maintaining discipline and morale.
• Inventory and Cost Control: Managing inventory involves ordering ingredients, tracking usage, minimizing waste, and
ensuring that supplies are fresh and appropriately stored. Chefs must also monitor food costs and adjust menus or
portion sizes to maintain profitability.
• Food Safety and Sanitation: Chefs enforce food safety regulations and hygiene standards. This includes maintaining a
clean kitchen, ensuring proper storage and handling of ingredients, and preventing cross-contamination or foodborne
illnesses.
• Quality Control: It is the chef’s responsibility to ensure that every plate leaving the kitchen is of the highest quality.
This includes taste-testing, checking for proper presentation, and ensuring consistency across all dishes.
• Collaboration with Management: Chefs often work closely with restaurant owners, managers, and front-of-house staff
to coordinate service, manage budgets, and develop marketing strategies.
• Customer Interaction: In some establishments, chefs engage directly with guests, gathering feedback,
accommodating special requests, and representing the restaurant’s culinary vision.

If you would like to discuss the role further, please click APPLY and send through an up-to date CV. We can schedule in
a time to discuss the positions available and what will be best suited to you.
